moe_factor.basis: measured on unified-memory hardware only (Strix Halo, DGX Spark); EXTRAPOLATED to other hardware, where there is no calibration data, so MoE estimates there are likely optimistic

calibration.method: efficiency = measured_tg / (memory_bandwidth_GBps / read_GB); dense models only; read_GB = params*bits_per_weight/8 >= 3.0 GB; single-device; median; per-hardware factor needs >= 3 rows, else per-kind median, else the global assumption.
